dict.string: Summarize a YouTube video with youtube-helper — runs in background, opens the markdown when done.

Q="{query}" [ -z "$Q" ] && Q="$(pbpaste)"
MODE=summary case "$Q" in lecture\ *) MODE=lecture; Q="${Q#lecture }";; summary\ *) Q="${Q#summary }";; esac
# trim surrounding whitespace Q="$(printf '%s' "$Q" | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]+//; s/[[:space:]]+$//')"
case "$Q" in *youtube.com/*|*youtu.be/*) ;; *) /usr/bin/osascript -e 'display notification "not a YouTube URL" with title "youtube-helper"'; exit 0;; esac
/usr/bin/osascript -e 'display notification "Summarizing… may take a few minutes" with title "youtube-helper"' MODE="$MODE" nohup ./summarize.sh "$Q" >/dev/null 2>&1 & exit 0

Summarize YouTube videos with youtube-helper.
Setup: 1. Store key: security add-generic-password -a "$USER" -s OPENAI_API_KEY -w "sk-..." 2. Install binary: go install ./cmd/youtube-helper 3. Trigger: type yt <url> (or copy a URL and type yt). Add lecture for conspect mode: yt lecture <url>.
Result opens automatically when ready. Output: ~/Documents/YouTube Summaries/
